sentences.en: These automobiles, for the most part, are manufactured in Japan.
sentences.zh: 这些汽车大多是在日本制造的。

sentences.en: He likes to boast about his father's successful automobile business.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢炫耀自己父亲成功的汽车事业。

sentences.en: He had his only son killed in an automobile accident.
sentences.zh: 他的独生子死于一场车祸。

senses.zh: [ 过去式 automobiled 过去分词 automobiled 现在分词 automobiling ]
